items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Tiny. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah. You could get about 25 or 30 people in there...

ctx.x: We got there, went out there and played for White folks. Went out and played, and the hall was just about as big as this house...
